records.name: Fader
records.tagline: Minimize windows when you switch apps automatically
records.description: A lightweight macOS menu bar app that automatically minimizes background windows when you switch apps — so you always have a clean, focused workspace.

records.name: Rubber Duck
records.tagline: Cross-model reviews in GitHub Copilot CLI
records.description: Rubber Duck is a new experimental mode in GitHub Copilot CLI that uses a second model from a different AI family to review plans, implementations, and tests before the agent moves forward. It is designed to catch architectural mistakes, edge cases, and cross-file issues earlier.

records.name: Lunagraph
records.tagline: Your design canvas that writes code powered by AI
records.description: Lunagraph is a design canvas — like Figma, but everything you add is real HTML, CSS, and React. Hand-craft UIs from scratch with granular control, or ask Claude to make sweeping changes. Designers, founders, and engineers all work on the same canvas.

records.name: Rudel
records.tagline: Claude Code & Codex session analytics for dev teams
records.description: We connected 1,573 real Claude Code sessions and found that skills fire in only 4% of sessions, 26% get abandoned within 60 seconds, and error patterns in the first 2 minutes predict failure. So we turned it into Rudel and release it to the world. Rudel gives your dev team a dashboard for token usage, session patterns, session errors, and quality signals across every team member. Works also for Codex. It's free, open source and self-hostable.

records.name: PrettyMux
records.tagline: The linux terminal built for Agents and Multiplexing
records.description: Native Linux GTK4 app built on Ghostty with vertical tabs, split panes, and agent notification rings. Streamline your workflow using lightning-fast quick search, command navigation, and seamless browser integration. Fully extensible and automatable via a powerful socket API designed for advanced developer control.

records.name: DreamBooks
records.tagline: Discover children’s books and track reading together.
records.description: Dreambooks helps families discover children's books by age, grade level, awards, series, and favorite authors. Kids can track reading together in communities, and every book links to your library so the next great read is easy to find and borrow.

records.name: Smuggl
records.tagline: Share your localhost as an invite only link
records.description: Smuggl lets you share your localhost as a secure link instead of blindly exposing your computer to the whole internet.

records.name: ScreenSmooth
records.tagline: Beautiful Screen Recordings in minutes
records.description: ScreenSmooth makes your mouse movement smooth, automatically zooms in on clicks, applies cinematic motion blur to all the animations, and adds beautiful background around your recording. In a minute your recording becomes a high-quality promotional. (Avaliable as Chrome Extension so work on MacOS, Windows, Linux)

records.name: Vocabulex
records.tagline: AI Vocabulary Flashcards that Adapt to Your Memory
records.description: • Adaptive spaced repetition • AI-powered explanations and examples • Your vocabulary, not collections you never use • Review only what you’re about to forget • Learn less, remember more

records.name: Claude Managed Agents
records.tagline: Pre-built agent harness on managed infrastructure
records.description: Claude Managed Agents is a suite of composable APIs for building and deploying cloud-hosted agents. It handles sandboxing, authentication, tool execution, long-running sessions, and multi-agent coordination, letting teams focus on user experience while shipping production agents up to 10x faster

records.name: SaveMRR
records.tagline: See how much you're losing to failed payments on Stripe
records.description: Paste a restricted Stripe API key. In 60 seconds, see how much MRR you're losing to failed payments, cancellations, and disengaged customers. Free, no account needed. Fix issues with 6 engines running automatically: * Dunning emails * Smart cancel flow * Churn prediction * Win-back sequences * Engagement triggers Pricing: * $19/mo Starter * $49/mo Growth * $99/mo Scale Flat fee. First $200 recovered free. 2x guarantee or full refund. Pricing locked for first 150 Founding members

records.name: Lukan AI Agent, IDE and workstation.
records.tagline: The open-source AI workstation for coding, ops, and life
records.description: Lukan is an open-source AI workstation that runs on top of your operating system to complete real end-to-end work. It includes an integrated coding agent that can read and edit files, run terminal commands, and automate technical tasks. Its terminals are tmux-based for persistent sessions, and you can run multiple agents either directly in terminal panes or through the agent UI. You can also create agentic pipelines to automate multi-step workflows with approvals and notifications.

records.name: SuperCmd
records.tagline: Open source alternative to Raycast Pro
records.description: SueprCmd is MacOs Launcher — open source alternative to Raycast Pro, WisprFlow, and Speechify in one place. With Raycast-compatible extensions, unlimited clipboard, notes, snippets, Excalidraw canvases, voice dictation with local models, text-to-speech from any app, a powerful calculator with live currency conversions, and AI via your own key or Ollama. Open source productivity suite to 10x yourself

records.name: BeMorphy
records.tagline: Your landing page, rewritten for every ad you run
records.description: BeMorphy rewrites your landing page copy in real time for every visitor, based on the ad they clicked. One script tag. Any website. No new pages to build, no ad changes, no design briefs. Get more conversions from the traffic you already pay for.

records.name: PillFloat
records.tagline: Move the Wispr Flow pill anywhere on your screen
records.description: Wispr Flow's dictation pill is locked to bottom-center. PillFloat moves it anywhere — top, side, corner, wherever it's out of your way. Free, open source, installs via Homebrew in 30 seconds. Built with macOS Accessibility APIs. Works as a lightweight menu bar utility — set your position, forget it exists.

records.name: ZenX
records.tagline: Your Twitter feed, finally peaceful
records.description: You open Twitter to see what people are building. You get war updates and election arguments instead. ZenX fixes that — it silently collapses toxic, political, and controversial tweets as you scroll. 100% local. No data collected. Free & open source. Chrome, Brave, Edge, Firefox.

records.name: ConceptSeek
records.tagline: Find concepts across videos and text instantly
records.description: ConceptSeek is a tool for finding specific concepts within YouTube videos, podcasts, lectures, and long-form research documents. It enables users to pinpoint exact passages and moments across a vast array of content from user-specified sources. It allows users to directly navigate to any search result in its original context. The tool supports broader searching beyond specific keyword match, allowing users to find thematic connections and abstract ideas across multiple sources of content.

records.name: AgentMail
records.tagline: Email Inboxes for AI Agents
records.description: AgentMail gives every AI agent its own email inbox. Your agent sends, receives, threads, and replies to emails on its own. No shared mailboxes, no OAuth per inbox, no human in the loop. Real-time webhooks and websockets. Semantic search across inboxes. Built-in email parsing and attachment extraction. Developers, startups, and enterprises are already deploying email agents with AgentMail. Free to start.

records.name: Origin
records.tagline: AI-powered confidential dev environment focused on privacy
records.description: ORGN CDE is the enterprise AI IDE for developers who require privacy. A powerful AI code generator and software development tool guaranteeing security with confidential computing, provable encryption, and zero data retention.

records.name: GAIA
records.tagline: Proactive personal assistant that handles your day
records.description: GAIA is a personal assistant that proactively manages your emails, tasks, and schedule. Instead of just answering questions, it takes action across your apps to clear your inbox and organize your to-do list for you. By learning how you work and handling the daily noise, it frees you to focus on your actual work rather than managing your tools.

records.name: Orca
records.tagline: Your control center for parallel AI agents
records.description: Run Claude Code, Codex, etc. in parallel across isolated worktrees. Orca combines Ghostty-style terminals, git worktrees, rich markdown editor, and fast agent output review into a single desktop app built for parallel development. Bring your own agents, plug into your workflow, and ship 10x, or even 100x faster. Free. Open source. Works on MacOS, Windows and Linux

records.name: GitQuest
records.tagline: Learn Git by solving challenges in a fake terminal
records.description: GitQuest helps you learn Git by practicing, not watching tutorials. Solve interactive investigations in a simulated terminal, make mistakes safely, and build real Git skills step by step. Includes a mobile app, daily challenges, and a certificate. Free and accessible to everyone

records.name: Motn AI
records.tagline: Vibe-code motion graphics on one canvas
records.description: Motn.ai is a visual canvas where you prompt animations and get back code, not flat video you can't touch. It's faster, more playful, and more visual than coding in an IDE. Just start jamming with vibe motion. Use images, videos, 3D, connect brand colors and fonts, generate images and video, and iterate by saying "make it slower". Compare variants side by side, pick the strongest, export as code or MP4. Drop it into Framer, Lovable, or any React site. No keyframes. Just ship.

records.name: Chaterm
records.tagline: Deploy, fix, and automate your infra in one terminal
records.description: Chaterm is the Claude Code for SREs and DevOps — built for real infrastructure. Describe your goal, and let Chaterm execute it end-to-end — from deploy to diagnose. It transforms team knowledge into reusable Agent Skills, automating complex workflows and removing repetitive work across your infrastructure.

records.name: RaptorCI
records.tagline: Catch risky code changes and weak tests before they ship
records.description: RaptorCI focuses on risk, not output. While most tools generate comments, rules, or pass/fail checks, they don’t show what could actually break. RaptorCI analyses pull requests to identify high-impact changes, explains their potential impact, and gives a clear signal of how safe a change is to ship. Built after seeing risky changes repeatedly slip through review in production systems, it’s already being used by teams reviewing real pull requests and iterating quickly based on feedback.

records.name: Mozilla 0DIN AI Scanner
records.tagline: Scan any LLM chatbot for vulnerabilities
records.description: Monitor, measure, and mitigate GenAI model vulnerabilities through real-time analytics, automated probing, and insights driven from thousands of human researchers. The 0DIN Scanner delivers continuous assurance that your models remain secure. Test for jailbreaks, prompt injections, and data leakage in minutes. Deploy via Docker or SaaS, get a full security report, and compare your results against base lines from the frontier providers.

records.name: DMARKOFF
records.tagline: Simplified and total DMARC control
records.description: Developed by a team with 20+ years of experience in email deliverability, DMARKOFF is powerful enough for pros, and simple enough for everyone. You can manage all your domains in one place, organize them into projects, and share access safely. Instead of tying cost to messages, users or features, the pricing is simple: just $10 per domain, with unlimited reports and users. Unsure about what to fix first? Your personal AI assistant will help you analyze DMARC reports and provide clear next steps.

records.name: Task Bert
records.tagline: Fully local open-source agent for managing your texts
records.description: Bert is the private iMessage assistant that I want Siri to be. Search your messages locally on your Mac to find buried details, turn loose plans into reminders or calendar events, and get nudged to follow up on conversations that slipped through the cracks. Bring your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key for AI features, so your message history stays on-device and under your control – no middle man, and fully open sourced.

records.name: Voquill on iOS & Android
records.tagline: The open source WisprFlow alternative, now on mobile
records.description: The open-source alternative to WisprFlow is now available on iOS and Android. Type 4x faster by using your voice. Works in any app, and now even on the go. Voquill gives you full control over where your voice data goes: bring your own API key, use our cloud, or stand up your own server. Voquill even works for highly regulated industries since all data is kept in-house

records.name: riffle
records.tagline: An infinite, collaborative playground for music creation
records.description: Riffle is an infinite, collaborative ecosystem for music creation, where every idea has the space and support it needs to find its shape. Cook up a riff, add your friends and collaborators to it, and build it out with sample packs, instruments, audio, and some help with the resident sous chef who can create, analyze, critique, and guide you. Go make some noise.

records.name: Meta Muse Spark
records.tagline: Meta's smart multimodal AI that understands your world
records.description: Muse Spark is a people-first AI model by Meta, built for everyday users and developers. It stands out with multimodal understanding, fast reasoning, and subagent workflows—delivering smarter answers, visual insights, and real-time, context-aware assistance.

records.name: Refaire
records.tagline: Multimodal AI Technician for the Physical World
records.description: Refaire helps hardware companies automate product technical support when issues require physical diagnosis. Technicians or customers' "facetime" to show and describe the problem, and Refaire uses vision, voice, and product knowledge to diagnose issues, guide troubleshooting, recommend the right parts or services, and escalate to a human with full session context.

records.name: Fonic
records.tagline: Turn messy work into interactive, actionable reports
records.description: Fonic.ai turns scattered inputs into professional, interactive reports in minutes. Connect your tools via MCP or paste your raw material, and it automatically generates a polished report ready to share (the more diverse your inputs, the richer the report!). Recipients can chat with an AI inside the report and approve action items, eliminating endless back-and-forth across emails or threads. Use Fonic for weekly updates, campaign recaps, project summaries, and more. Fully free while in beta.

records.name: Zoneless
records.tagline: Open-source Stripe Connect alternative with $0.002 fees
records.description: Zoneless is a free, open-source drop-in replacement for Stripe Connect using USDC. Identical API, but payouts cost $0.002 and settle instantly across 220+ countries. Battle-tested for 3 months on PromptBase, processing 1,400+ payouts and cutting my $9,400/mo Stripe fees to ~$5. If you know how to use Stripe, you already know Zoneless.

records.name: Convert or Not
records.tagline: Simulate first-time users. See why they drop off
records.description: Convert or Not simulates first-time user sessions on your site. It clicks, scrolls, and attempts to complete key actions like signup, revealing where your target users hesitate, drop and why. Use it to understand and fix conversion gaps before real users are lost.

records.name: ReminderOS
records.tagline: Reminders that keep up with you
records.description: Never miss what matters with flexible schedules, one-tap snooze and reminders that stay in sync across your devices.

records.name: Awshar AI
records.tagline: Understands India's nuanced digital conversations
records.description: AI-driven tool that extracts real-time insights from billions of social media discussions.

records.name: brag.fast
records.tagline: You ship features and they deserve to be seen
records.description: Developers ship features but never announce them and brag.fast fixes that. Four ways: Kitchen UI (no code), REST API, via AI (MCP), or Github app. 30 free credits (no card required).

records.name: MacWipe
records.tagline: Disable your keyboard + trackpad to safely clean your screen
records.description: Clean Mode is a simple macOS utility that disables your keyboard and trackpad so you can safely clean your screen. No accidental clicks, no shortcuts triggered, just wipe and hold Escape to exit.

records.name: Grass
records.tagline: Gives your coding agent a dedicated VM that's ready 24/7
records.description: Grass gives your coding agent a dedicated VM that's always ready. No setup, no config, no burning your laptop. Point Claude Code or OpenCode at it and run. Monitor progress from your phone, steer mid-session, push changes, all without touching your machine. Every new account gets 10 hours free. No credit card needed.

records.name: ProdShort
records.tagline: Turn meetings into ready-to-post shorts and posts
records.description: Founders fail at content because it's time consuming and AI just still feels fake. Prodshort fixes that. We don’t generate content. We capture it. Everything you say in meetings is already valuable. We cut it, refine it, and turn it into ready-to-post shorts, Linkedin, Twitter... Automatically. No scripts. No fake voice. No overthinking. Just you, turned into content.

records.name: Show Me a Leaderboard
records.tagline: Use friendly competition to build and strengthen community
records.description: Show Me a Leaderboard helps companies, nonprofits and friend groups easily launch friendly (or intense!) competitions, with custom leaderboards, badges, forums, and notifications.

records.name: Brila
records.tagline: One-page websites from real Google Maps reviews
records.description: Website generators give you a template with made-up copy. You rewrite it for hours – still sounds generic. Brila does content first. It reads your Google Maps reviews, finds why customers actually choose you using Jobs to Be Done, and builds a one-page site from real patterns, real wording, real photos. When a business has enough reviews, the results often surprise even the owners. Not a single prompt – a serious AI system behind every website. Free plan gives you a fully generated site.

records.name: Onform.work
records.tagline: Build forms with Claude
records.description: Onform makes form creation, data collection, and management fully conversational. It's MCP-native so you can build and manage forms directly from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible tool using plain language. Build forms through natural language via MCP, or use the dashboard if you prefer. Onform is built by Founding Dev, an AI-powered SaaS replacement platform helping teams vibe-code complex internal software from customizable templates — cutting build time and maintenance headaches.

records.name: Ycode Open Source
records.tagline: The open-source alternative to Webflow
records.description: Most website builders like Webflow or Framer lock you in. Ycode is an open-source alternative that puts you back in control, with everything you need to build professional websites—including MCP connections for AI tools.

records.name: Cutsio
records.tagline: Your entire video library, now searchable and editable by AI
records.description: Cutsio turns your entire video library into something you can actually use. Upload footage, get transcripts + chapters, and search by meaning. Ask for moments, generate rough cuts, and export to Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Stop scrubbing timelines - start asking your videos.

records.name: SwiftMotion
records.tagline: 58 animations, 31 shaders, 5 games in one Xcode project
records.description: I spent months recreating every animation I saw in top App Store apps. 58 animations. 5 games. 31 Metal shaders. Zero dependencies. → Text effects: liquid, glitch, magnet, vortex, typewriter → Image effects: parallax, chromatic, noise dissolve, halftone → Buttons: Duolingo 3D, jelly, neon glow, liquid fill → 5 playable games in pure SwiftUI → 5 production-ready welcome screens with haptics Clone → Open in Xcode → Run.

records.name: Observer
records.tagline: Live logs inside your IDE to Debug without context switching
records.description: Have you ever felt fatigued by constantly switching between your IDE and observability tools when debugging? I kept losing my flow every time I had to leave VS Code to check PostHog. So, I built Observer to live stream logs right where I code. Now I catch issues faster and fix them without losing context. I hope it makes your debugging more efficient too.

records.name: Bouncer
records.tagline: Filter (and heal) your Twitter feed
records.description: Twitter's algorithm is optimized for attention, not for you. We want to change that. Bouncer is a Chrome extension and iPhone app that filters out what you don't want to see: a phrase, a topic, a tone. How it works: A small language model is used to understand context from keywords. Filter out "AI doomerism" or "crypto" or even something as broad as "arrogance." And because Twitter's algorithm learns from what you look at, or don't, using Bouncer starts to heal the feed itself.

records.name: Cred
records.tagline: OAuth credential delegation for AI agents
records.description: AI agents need OAuth tokens for user accounts, but most frameworks store them in plaintext config files. Cred is open-source credential delegation middleware. The user consents once. Cred encrypts the refresh token (AES-256-GCM) and never returns it. Agents get short-lived tokens on demand. Every delegation produces a cryptographic audit receipt. We also ship CredX: a single-command encrypted credential store for agents who don't need the full SDK. Self-hosted. Apache 2.0. Zero cloud dependency.

records.name: ProtoFlow
records.tagline: AI-powered schematic design tool for PCB making
records.description: ProtoFlow is the new step zero for electronic design. Through its modern interface, universal component search, and powerful AI assistant, ProtoFlow optimizes the schematic design portion of PCB making, slicing hours off of the process. The service is free to use, and exports smoothly to softwares like KiCad and Altium, allowing users at any skill level to fully optimize their schematic design.

records.name: Cyris
records.tagline: Turns every AI decision into audit-ready evidence
records.description: Your AI agents make thousands of decisions a day. Can you prove what they did? Cyris auto-instruments 12+ LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini, Ollama, more) with zero code changes. Every decision is logged into a tamper-proof, hash-chained audit trail. When a hospital sends a 200-question security questionnaire, Cyris auto-fills the answers from your real agent data in 90 seconds. Two lines of code. Agents discovered in 10 seconds. Your next compliance review writes itself.

records.name: Offsite
records.tagline: Build teams of humans and agents, watch them work.
records.description: Offsite is a new paradigm for work: bring your humans and agents into one team. Organize them in a live org chart and watch collaboration unfold in real time. No more agents siloed in tabs or terminals, they work alongside humans, talking and coordinating as a system. See every conversation, approve real-world actions, and run your team with full visibility and control. Out-of-the-box integrations with agents you already use like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and any MCP-compatible agent.

records.name: Startups.RIP
records.tagline: Rebuild 1,738+ dead YC startups with AI
records.description: Startups often fail because of timing, not ideas. Startups.RIP is a wiki of 1,700+ YC startups that shut down or got acquired. Our AI research agent writes a detailed post-mortem (what they built, why they failed, what's changed since) and a rebuild playbook with implementation-ready technical specs you can drop straight into your AI coding agent. Every failed startup is a validated market with unfinished business. Shortcut the idea maze. Start with what almost worked.

records.name: RunMap
records.tagline: Turn your Strava runs into a world map adventure
records.description: Most running apps focus on metrics. RunMap adds the missing layer: exploration. Connect your Strava in one click and watch your runs appear on an interactive world map. Unlock 50+ badges across 5 categories and 4 rarity tiers as you discover new countries, continents, cities and terrains. A complement to Strava: Your splits stay there, your adventures get a home. No subscription, no ads. Built solo from the road during a 1-year trip across Latin America.

records.name: Recost
records.tagline: Your API costs fully visible.
records.description: Recost shows you exactly what code is burning money before your API bill explodes. It maps cost to endpoints, flags waste like duplicate calls and bad loops, and simulates scale impact. With AST analysis and runtime tracking, you don’t just track spend, you control it before it gets out of hand.

records.name: Slm-mesh
records.tagline: Your AI coding sessions can finally talk to each other
records.description: SLM Mesh is an open-source MCP server that gives AI coding agents peer-to-peer communication. SLM Mesh fixes this with 8 MCP tools: - Peer discovery (scoped by machine, directory, or git repo) - Direct messaging + broadcast - Shared key-value state - File locking with auto-expire - Event bus for real-time coordination Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, Windsurf, Codex, VS Code — any MCP-compatible agent. npm install -g slm-mesh

records.name: Doing
records.tagline: Voice and visual context for AI builders. No subscription.
records.description: Doing is for AI builders who use voice and screenshots to bring context to Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents. Tap a hotkey and Doing listens. Optimized over thousands of hours of building with Claude & Codex. Blazing fast, private, local, no account, no subs. Just a quality tool that you own and works well.

records.name: Clickport
records.tagline: The modern, powerful Google Analytics alternative
records.description: Clickport is a modern, powerful analytics suite that lets you track, analyze, and improve your website's performance. It is simple to use, privacy-friendly (no cookies, no consent banners) yet packed with features: engagement metrics, visitors journey, click tracking, filtering, goal conversions, custom events, advanced bot protection, AI-powered insights and much more. Clickport is the smart way to track the performance of your website, online store or app. Start your free trial today!

records.name: BAREMAIL ʕ·ᴥ·ʔ
records.tagline: Minimalist Gmail client for bad wifi connections
records.description: BAREMAIL — email's bare necessities. A minimalist, open-source Gmail client built for spotty connections. Airplane wifi. Rural networks. Developing regions. Anywhere Gmail's multi-megabyte interface refuses to load — BAREMAIL gets your email through in kilobytes. Get BAREMAIL on GitHub: https://github.com/matt-virgo/baremail

records.name: OpenResource
records.tagline: Discover open-source tools with an AI chat assistant
records.description: OpenResource is a curated directory of open-source projects, tools, Windows apps, Android apps, and GitHub repos. Instead of endless searching, just ask — the built-in AI chat (powered by Mistral AI) understands natural language queries like: → "Find a ree music streaming app for android" → "What's the best open-source video editor for Windows?" → "Suggest any note taking app"

records.name: Morsel
records.tagline: Strava for cooking
records.description: Morsel is the social networking app for cooking. Follow your friends, see what they are making, get inspired!

records.name: TNREGINET
records.tagline: TNREGINET guide & updates https://tnrginet.com/
records.description: TNREGINET is the official Tamil Nadu Registration portal to check EC online, guideline value, stamp duty, Patta Chitta and property registration details.

records.name: Soolo
records.tagline: AI brand studio for Shopify merchants
records.description: Soolo gives Shopify merchants one place to create social content, posts, and video ads, then build the campaigns and ad copy needed to market them across channels. What makes it different is that it works from real Shopify store data, product context, and existing assets. It also supports product analysis, brand fit checks, content ideas, and email writing. Built to save time, reduce cost, and reduce tool sprawl. Also available as a web app.

records.name: GeniOS
records.tagline: The Context Intelligence for AI Agents
records.description: Memory is a commodity. Chunking + Embeddings + Vector DB = Memory. And still, your AI agents struggle. The real problem is context intelligence. Agents remember everything but understand nothing. GeniOS gives your agents the context intelligence they are missing. One API call. Full organizational context. Real automation. 50+ AI builders validated this gap. 5 startups across Shark Tank, Harvard, and Antler ecosystems are already building on GeniOS.

records.name: Fader
records.tagline: Minimize windows when you switch apps automatically
records.description: A lightweight macOS menu bar app that automatically minimizes background windows when you switch apps — so you always have a clean, focused workspace.

records.name: Kubeez Cut
records.tagline: Browser video editor with 1-click AI, no installs
records.description: KubeezCut is a free, open-source video editor that runs entirely in your browser — powered by WebGPU and WebCodecs. No installation. No account required. Multi-track timeline, 30+ GPU-accelerated real-time effects, keyframe animation, local Whisper transcription, export to MP4/WebM/MOV with H264/H265/VP9/AV1. 1-click AI: Drop AI-generated images, video, music, or voiceover from Kubeez.com directly into your timeline. Early beta, open source.

records.name: Lovable
records.tagline: Top-rated calculator application
records.description: An advanced calculator for everything you can imagine.

records.name: Read What Matters
records.tagline: A personalised email digest for tech people
records.description: Personalised email digest for tech people. Choose from blogs, popular news sources, and feeds that matter to you, delivered as one clean daily email. It's fully customisable so you can make it the way you want it to.

records.name: ClearTouch
records.tagline: One platform to run, monitor & scale your contact center
records.description: ClearTouch is a cloud-based contact center platform built for enterprises managing high-volume, high-impact customer interactions. Most contact center teams are stuck stitching together disconnected tools — separate dialers, CRMs, analytics dashboards, and workforce tools. ClearTouch replaces all of that with one unified platform: voice, digital channels, AI analytics, automation, and compliance — all working together in real time.

records.name: Rubber Duck
records.tagline: Cross-model reviews in GitHub Copilot CLI
records.description: Rubber Duck is a new experimental mode in GitHub Copilot CLI that uses a second model from a different AI family to review plans, implementations, and tests before the agent moves forward. It is designed to catch architectural mistakes, edge cases, and cross-file issues earlier.

records.name: SaaSReadyit
records.tagline: Validate your SaaS idea before you build the wrong thing.
records.description: Most SaaS products don't fail at execution — they fail at validation. SaaSReadyit.com delivers AI-powered market validation reports in under 3 minutes. Starter, Professional, or Expert tier — covering competitive landscape, buyer psychology, market sizing, and go/no-go signals. Delivered as adocx to your inbox. Built for founders who want conviction before commitment. Enter your idea. Get your report. Stop guessing. Start validating.

records.name: Orthia AI
records.tagline: The AI Front-Desk for Orthodontic Clinics
records.description: rthia is an AI front desk platform built exclusively for orthodontic practices. It answers every inbound call 24/7 with natural voice AI, books appointments directly into your practice management system (Cloud 9, Dolphin, Ortho2, Dentrix, and 65+ others), and verifies orthodontic insurance eligibility in real time during the call. No missed patients. No voicemail. No after-hours gaps. Built for ortho workflows, not general dental. Live in under one hour.

records.name: True Form X
records.tagline: AI workout/sport form check - and a detailed baseline scan
records.description: Most people lift with zero feedback. Coaches cost $100/hr. True Form X uses your phone camera + AI to score every rep of your squat, deadlift, bench - plus basketball shots, golf swings, soccer kicks, and 20+ movements. You get: angle-level biomechanical breakdown, injury risk flags, percentile rankings, and a personalized fix-it plan. Full Scan mode runs 10 tests in 15 min - body comp, mobility, power, posture - like a $300 DEXA + FMS for $99. Free to start. No hardware needed.

records.name: Lunagraph
records.tagline: Your design canvas that writes code powered by AI
records.description: Lunagraph is a design canvas — like Figma, but everything you add is real HTML, CSS, and React. Hand-craft UIs from scratch with granular control, or ask Claude to make sweeping changes. Designers, founders, and engineers all work on the same canvas.
